Class CidrBlock

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.api.CidrBlock
public final class CidrBlock extends Object
A block of IP addresses in CIDR notation: "10.0.0.0/8", "2001:db8::/32", or a single address such as "192.168.1.10" (a /32 or /128 block).

Parsing never resolves a name: only IPv4 dotted-quad and IPv6 literals are accepted, so building a selector cannot trigger a DNS lookup (or a DNS chaos scenario). IPv4 and IPv6 are separate families: an IPv4 block never contains an IPv6 address and vice versa. The JDK reports an IPv4-mapped IPv6 peer (::ffff:a.b.c.d) as an IPv4 address, so an IPv4-mapped block with a prefix of at least 96 bits is parsed as the IPv4 block it maps.
